findings.issue: Verification was tests-only: no browser view of the /team page or the add/remove button, no server start, no HTTP probe — the new UI's look and the acknowledged 'Your team is empty' flash on SPA navigation were never observed.

summary: A tight, fast session: it read everything relevant first, chose a cookie-based SSR-safe design deliberately, and passed the full 63-test suite on its first run after the last edit. Tool discipline was mediocre — a heredoc-corrupted file, one edit miss, a stray /tmp write, and a bogus npx tsc typecheck. Verification never went beyond the test suite: no browser or server inspection of the new team pages at all.
